plan.title: "Forgot the pic" again: ask for other proof, a warm miss, and an offer to change how they prove it

context.text: hit legs today but forgot the pic again 🤦
I believe you Chris, but no pic, no check mark. Tomorrow: gym selfie before you leave. Deal?

transcript.text: went to the gym, forgot to take the pic AGAIN. I swear I went

I believe you, Chris, but today stays a miss without proof. If you've got anything from the gym tonight, like a Planet Fitness app check-in screenshot, send it and it still counts. Tomorrow, take the selfie the second you walk in, before your first set. 6 pm, you've got this 💪
nah I don't track anything, I just lift

Totally fair, Chris, so today stays a miss. Tomorrow we fix it at the source. Selfie the second you walk in at 6 pm, before your first set, and then the lift is yours. Want to set a phone reminder for 5:55 so it's the first thing you do?
yeah honestly I always forget the selfie, I'm in the zone

That makes sense, Chris. When you're locked in, a selfie is the first thing to go. We can change how you prove it, but not skip it. How about a 30-second voice note as you leave the gym, saying what you lifted? You'll be done and headed out, so it's easier to remember. Want to switch to that?

checks.reason: Names only a screenshot of the gym app check-in and a selfie as proof, never typed text.
Roughly four short sentences, with no question at the end; it runs a little past the one-to-three limit.
Warm and encouraging, with the emoji used as punctuation and no accusation.
Names only the selfie as proof for tomorrow.
Four sentences, with one question at the end; slightly over the three-sentence limit.
Warm and sincere, never suspicious, with no emoji row.
Offers a 30-second voice note as the proof, which is an allowed proof kind.
Five or six sentences and two questions, clearly over the one-to-three sentence and one-question limits.
Warm, understanding and never accusing, with no emoji or energy problems.

conversation.reason: ZOH first asks for a gym app check-in screenshot, then accepts today as a warm miss.
After repeated forgotten selfies, ZOH offers a voice note as you leave instead, without dropping proof.
Typed 'I just lift' earns no check mark, but the why-real-proof explanation is thin; the request for proof is clear.
ZOH asks for any screenshot first, makes today a warm miss, then offers a voice note fitted to them and keeps proof.

grade.summary: ZOH handled the forgotten-selfie trouble warmly: it asked for a gym check-in screenshot first, kept today a miss without accusation, and then offered a voice note on the way out instead of dropping proof. Its texts ran long on the short rule, with ZOH 3 also asking two questions, but the proof handling and tone were sound.
